description: This file contains an implementation of a content file manager for static content in a sales management system. It manages files like images, CSS, JS, PDFs, and videos for merchants, stored in an Infinispan cache. The class provides methods for adding, retrieving, listing, and removing files, using Infinispan's tree cache structure. It also includes singleton access and cache management utilities.

classes.name: CmsStaticContentFileManagerInfinispanImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a file manager that handles static content for merchants, utilizing Infinispan's tree cache for storage and retrieval operations.

methods.name: stopFileManager
methods.description: Stops the cache manager, effectively shutting down the cache service.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of this class.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Stores a static content file (like images, CSS, JS) in the cache for a specified merchant store.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Stores multiple static content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a specific static content file based on merchant store, content type, and filename.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves all static content files of a specified type for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific file from the cache for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all files associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: getFileNames
methods.description: Lists the filenames of all files stored under a specific content type for a merchant store.
